build_cost.scope: build() entry through pinned-source extraction, staging, Cargo, source/tool/binary validation and receipt preparation; excludes final receipt write, Python imports and caller startup
build_cost.status: observed successful source-preserving build; compiler stream identities retained

fixed.analysis: fixed descriptive totals and ratios only; no confidence or independent-host inference
fixed.build_rule: same observed build B charged once to each standalone arm; per-call B/744; unknown stays null
fixed.call_clock: monotonic_ns immediately around invoke/evaluate, including returned receipt construction
fixed.decision_equality: all six arm pairs, every bundle/winner-list/selected-first-action field, type-sensitive JSON
fixed.excludes: imports, caller logging/audit, acquisition outside recorded build, optimized application execution
fixed.failure_rule: stop on first failure, close all acquired sessions, retain attempts/errors/unattempted slots
fixed.one_shot_startup_close: already inside invoke; separate startup/close terms are zero, not missing
fixed.order: fixed cases; forward arms iff (round + case_index) is even, otherwise reverse
fixed.primary: standalone service = sum(outer startup + complete API call + outer close)
fixed.session_clock: constructor and close measured separately, including their return; no request replay
